knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Signs of infection or inflammation are outside the service. The technician declines and refers.
The classification and registration requirement depends on the council, so it is checked for each service area.
The technician describes what was observed and refers the client. A diagnosis is not given.

practicalCriteria: Assessor presents a client with a visible skin or nail sign and observes the candidate decline, record and refer
Assessor checks that the candidate can state the council position for two services on the approved list, with the source
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of one declined service with reason and date
Written council position check for two services, with source and date
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate carries out a service on infected, inflamed or wounded skin or nails
The candidate gives a diagnosis to the client
